notes: Twelve source and twenty target IDs each partitioned once.
s002 אֲנִי takes only *I* while the copula joins the predicate adjective, as rule 20 directs where the clause writes its subject; the gapped second adjective takes no copula of its own (rule 34).
Both כְּ phrases are anarthrous in Hebrew, so each construct noun takes a supplied *the* under rules 15 and 29 and each proper-name rectum takes the relational *of* under rule 19.
